d.ctx: The user asks if the expert has Snapchat. The expert asks what they will do with it.
d.j: Proposing to move to an external app.

d.ctx: The user asks for the expert's number after asking for Snapchat.
d.j: Asking for a phone number to move contact outside the app.

d.seg: नंबर पर पेमेंट करना पड़ेगा क्या
d.tr: Do I have to pay on the number?
d.ctx: The user asks if they need to pay on the number they requested.
d.j: Asking about payment linked to an external contact method.

d.tr: Will you show what I say?
d.ctx: The user is asking the expert to show their body.
The user insists on the expert showing their body.

d.seg: एक बार दिखा दो बेबी एक बार बस थोड़ा सा दिखाना
d.tr: Show me once baby, just a little bit.
d.ctx: The user continues to pressure the expert to show their body.
